This is a made-up worker. The worker gets soup ready for a meal. The job could be cook. The clue is making food for a meal. A bowl and spoon could help with that task. I use the task clue, not how the person looks.
follows a recipe to make a meal
puts plants in soil and waters them
puts items in a box and adds a label
Kit links: cook—bowl and spoon; cleaner—cloth and mop; gardener—plant pot and watering can; packer—box and label. These are plausible examples, not exclusive rules.
Daily-skill links: cook—follow steps; cleaner—keep a space clean; gardener—care for a plant; packer—sort and check. Accept a justified overlap, such as checking being useful in all four jobs.
